title: Pokemon Giratina V 130/196 Lost Origin Holo Rare NM
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Pokémon TCG — Giratina V, #130/196, Lost Origin (SWSH11).
Basic, HP 220. Attacks: Abyss Seeking (look at top 4 cards of your deck, put 2 into hand, rest to Lost Zone), Shred (160 dmg, unaffected by effects on opponent's Active). V rule — opponent takes 2 Prize cards on KO. Illustrated by 5ban Graphics.
Ungraded, near mint or better — see photos for the actual card. Ships sleeved in a top-loader inside a rigid mailer.
